items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Charlie Atkinson -- great dancers, and the girls' names I can't remember.

ctx.x: Yeah, Charlie Atkinson -- great dancers, and the girls' names I can't remember. Beautiful shows, and we had black and white shows. But of course, Barnet had made -- da da da -- mpton Poppin Turnpike was one of the big hits in Harlem, and another thing we made was -- oh, what was the name of it -- yeah, Tappin' at the Tapper.
Why don't we take a break for a minute, just to give you a break.
